_comment: Manual entry workflow — no serial hardware required.
_comment_2: Create load_series.json and displacement_series.json by hand from your readings.

load_series_format.description: Force in Newtons at each load step. Convert grams: mass_g * 0.00981

displacement_series_format.description: Centre deflection in mm at each load step. First column is step counter.

cli_example_strip_along_grain: python -m tap_tone_pi.bending.merge_and_moe --load load_series.json --disp displacement_series.json --out-dir ./out --method 3point --span 400 --width 20 --thickness 3.0 --specimen-type strip --grain-orientation longitudinal
cli_example_strip_cross_grain: python -m tap_tone_pi.bending.merge_and_moe --load load_series.json --disp displacement_series.json --out-dir ./out --method 3point --span 150 --width 20 --thickness 3.0 --specimen-type strip --grain-orientation cross
cli_example_full_plate: python -m tap_tone_pi.bending.merge_and_moe --load load_series.json --disp displacement_series.json --out-dir ./out --method 3point --span 400 --width 200 --thickness 3.2 --specimen-type full_plate --poisson 0.35 --grain-orientation longitudinal
